item.text:
We need to implement a simple Node.js server with SQLite, serving static HTML/JS for UI. Provide routes: GET / returns page with project list and creation UI. POST /projects to create? Could use JSON API via fetch from client. Simpler: server serves static files from public folder, and also provides API endpoints: GET /api/projects, POST /api/projects, GET /api/projects/:id, etc. For navigation, can use client-side routing (single page) or server-side rendering. Simpler: server returns HTML for list and for project page using templates (string interpolation). Use node:http to serve.

Need to persist data in SQLite file at DB_PATH env var. Use node:sqlite (which is experimental but Node 22 includes it). Use Database API.

Implement database schema: projects(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL). On server start, ensure table exists.

Implement API:

- GET /api/projects returns JSON array of {id, name} ordered by id asc (creation order).
- POST /api/projects with JSON {name}. Trim, if empty return 400 with error message.

- GET /api/projects/:id returns project.

Serve static assets from /static maybe.

HTML page at '/' will load script to fetch projects and render rows with data-testid="project-row". Provide input and button. On create, call POST, handle error by alert with message.

Project page at '/projects/<id>' can be separate HTML file served by server (maybe same index with client-side route). Simpler: server serves a simple page that displays project name heading, and button to go back.

Implement route handling in server.js using URL parsing.

Add health endpoint.

Add npm start script in package.json that runs node server.js.

Commit changes. Provide commit ID.

We need to run commands to set up repo. Let's explore repo.
We need to include justification field only when require_escalated. Not needed. Let's just run exec without justification.
Only package.json present. Need to create server.js, public files, maybe initialize npm? Already package.json exists; let's view it.
